record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, average full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy within each sampled sequence, then average those sequence losses across the batch. Equal sequence weighting may prevent longer histories, which contribute more masked positions, from dominating training on predominantly short histories. Use neither label smoothing nor extra final-position weighting, both of which previously regressed. Preserve masked-position sampling, features, embeddings, topology, scoring, appended-mask readout, optimizer and training settings; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Average masked-item cross-entropy within each sampled sequence, then average across sequences so histories with more masked targets do not dominate. Apply consistently to all four category models without label smoothing or final-position weighting; preserve sampling, architecture, inference and training settings.
